hero.lines:
Your home
*away from home*
in Paternoster.
hero.body: Two en-suite bedrooms, a lounge and kitchen of your own, and a private patio with a braai and hammocks.

rooms.alt: Bedroom one: a double bed on wooden floors, with a desk and an arched alcove
rooms.title:
Double bed,
*own bathroom*
rooms.text: A full-size double bed made up with good linen, its own en-suite bathroom, an internet TV and a table to work at. Patio doors open straight onto the garden.

rooms.alt: Bedroom two: two single beds with patterned covers and a window to the garden
rooms.title:
Two singles,
*garden doors*
rooms.text: Two single beds, an en-suite bathroom, internet TV and a work table — with its own door out to the patio, so early risers can slip out to the sea.

rooms.alt: The guest kitchen with wooden counters, open shelves and a dining table
rooms.title:
The
*kitchen*
rooms.text: A private lounge and dining area, and a fully equipped kitchen: fridge, microwave, kettle, hob, toaster, crockery and cleaning materials — everything for slow breakfasts and long, lazy suppers.

rooms.alt: The private patio with a wooden table, hammocks and the garden beyond
rooms.title:
Outside is
*the best room*
rooms.text: Your private patio has a braai, a fire bowl, an outdoor table, hammocks under the pergola, a garden and part sea views over the fynbos.

rules.label: Check-in
rules.value: 14:00 – 19:00. Please let us know your arrival time in advance.

rules.label: Pets
rules.value: Welcome by prior arrangement, at no extra charge.

rules.label: Children
rules.value: All ages welcome. We don’t have cots or extra beds.

rules.label: Check-in age
rules.value: The person checking in must be 18 or older.

rules.label: Smoking & parties
rules.value: No smoking indoors, and no parties or events.

notes: We live in the floors above. The flat shares a front entrance with our home, and 15 steps lead down from the front door to your lounge, so the flat is not suitable for wheelchairs.
Bokkoms has back-up power, so load-shedding won’t leave you in the dark.
The West Coast is water-wise country — please help us use water sparingly.
